name: Wood basics: logs, planks, sticks, crafting table, wooden pickaxe
context: Tier 1, starts from an empty inventory. Survival world, wherever the player is now; never assume coordinates, find things with mc_find_blocks. Never dig the block under your own feet or straight down; dig staircases or side tunnels. Avoid lava and deep water (mc_mine allowFluids only for sand/gravel at shores). Do not break blocks of player-built structures.

steps.name: chop 6 logs
steps.goal: Get 6 logs from the nearest tree. mc_mine block=#minecraft:logs count=6 radius=32 does it in one call: it finds the nearest exposed logs, walks to each and picks up the drops (bare hands work). If it stops early, call it again for the rest.

steps.name: craft 12 planks
steps.goal: Turn logs into at least 12 planks: mc_craft the planks matching your log type (oak_log -> oak_planks, spruce_log -> spruce_planks, ...) with times=3 (each log gives 4 planks).

steps.name: craft 4 sticks
steps.goal: Craft 4 sticks: mc_craft stick (2 planks give 4 sticks).

steps.name: craft a crafting table
steps.goal: Craft 1 crafting_table (4 planks, 2x2 recipe) with mc_craft crafting_table.

steps.name: craft a wooden pickaxe
steps.goal: Craft a wooden_pickaxe (3 planks + 2 sticks) at a crafting table. mc_craft handles the crafting table by itself (uses one within 6 blocks, or places yours or makes one from 4 planks, and picks it back up). Then mc_craft wooden_pickaxe.
